title: The Little Mermaid
moral: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로(합창 줄은 extra ch* 의 영어 합성), new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.mer:surface | mer:wobble:<x,ms> | mer:re: 물방울 올리며 위로 사라짐(2장) / 흔들흔들 걷기(wobbleWalk) / 왕자 머리를 받치고 헤엄(3장) / 거품이 되어 둥실 올라감(10장)

acts.ship:at:<x,y>:<lantern|tilt|flower> | sh: 배 / 폭풍(구름·큰 파도·흔들림·쿵) / 불꽃 세 개 펑! 펑!
acts.fish:drift | gulls:fly | bubbles:<x,y,n>: 물고기 떠다니기 / 갈매기 / 물방울 / 반짝 / 물 가림

acts.dance | dagger:give | dagger:throw | win: 둘이 춤(흔들흔들) / 단검이 인어공주 손으로 / 단검 풍덩! 물결 반짝, 해 뜸 / 휘잉~ 바람 두 줄기가 배를 밀어 줌

lines.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 인어 나라가 있었어요. 바다 왕님과 할머니, 여섯 공주가 살았지요.
lines.en: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.
segs: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.

lines.text: 물고기들이 살랑살랑 헤엄치고, 보글보글 물방울이 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Fish swished and swayed through the water, and bubbles went up, bloop, bloop.
segs: Fish swished and swayed through the water, and bubbles went up, bloop, bloop.

lines.text: 막내 인어공주는 조용하고 생각이 많았어요. 정원에는 배에서 떨어진 물건을 모았어요.
lines.en: The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.
segs: The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.

lines.text: 유리병과 동그란 돌이 반짝반짝, 차곡차곡 놓여 있었지요.
lines.en: Glass bottles and round stones sat there in neat little rows, all twinkly and bright.
segs: Glass bottles and round stones sat there in neat little rows, all twinkly and bright.

lines.text: 언니들은 열다섯 살이 되면 바다 위로 올라갔어요. 드디어 막내 차례예요!
lines.en: When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!
segs: When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!

lines.text: 할머니가 막내 인어공주에게 당부했어요.
lines.en: Grandmother had a gentle word for the youngest mermaid.
segs: Grandmother had a gentle word for the youngest mermaid.

lines.text: 조심해서 다녀오렴.
lines.en: Be careful, and come back safely.
segs: Be careful, and come back safely.

lines.text: 네, 할머니. 다녀올게요!
lines.en: Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!
segs: Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!

lines.text: 인어공주는 꼬리를 살랑살랑 흔들며 위로, 위로 헤엄쳐 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid swished her tail, swish, swish, and swam up, up, up.
segs: The little mermaid swished her tail, swish, swish, and swam up, up, up.

lines.text: 물 밖으로 고개를 쏙 내밀자, 별이 반짝반짝 빛났어요.
lines.en: She poked her head up out of the water, and the stars went twinkle, twinkle.
segs: She poked her head up out of the water, and the stars went twinkle, twinkle.

lines.text: 커다란 배가 있었어요. 오늘은 왕자님 생일이래요.
lines.en: There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.
segs: There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.

lines.text: 배에서는 둥둥 북소리와 하하 웃음소리가 흘러나왔어요.
lines.en: From the ship came the boom, boom of drums and the sound of laughter, ha, ha.
segs: From the ship came the boom, boom of drums and the sound of laughter, ha, ha.

lines.text: 펑! 펑! 불꽃이 하늘에 피었어요.
lines.en: Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.
segs: Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.

lines.text: "우와, 불꽃이 꽃처럼 활짝 피었어!"
lines.en: Wow, the fireworks are blooming like flowers!
segs: Wow, the fireworks are blooming like flowers!

lines.text: 인어공주가 배 위의 왕자님을 보며 속삭였어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid looked at the prince on the ship and whispered.
segs: The little mermaid looked at the prince on the ship and whispered.

lines.text: 저 사람이 왕자님이구나.
lines.en: So that is the prince.

lines.text: 인어공주는 눈을 동그랗게 뜨고 한참을 가만가만 바라보았어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid opened her eyes wide and gazed, ever so quietly, for a long, long time.
segs: The little mermaid opened her eyes wide and gazed, ever so quietly, for a long, long time.

lines.text: 밤이 깊자 바람이 세졌어요. 배가 기우뚱!
lines.en: Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!
segs: Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!

lines.text: 쏴아쏴아, 파도가 높이 솟고 번쩍 번개가 쳤어요.
lines.en: Whoosh, whoosh! The waves rose high, and lightning flashed, crack!
segs: Whoosh, whoosh! The waves rose high, and lightning flashed, crack!

lines.text: 왕자님이 바다에 빠졌어요.
lines.en: The prince fell into the sea.
segs: The prince fell into the sea.

lines.text: 인어공주가 물에 빠진 왕자님에게 헤엄쳐 갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid swam toward the prince in the water.
segs: The little mermaid swam toward the prince in the water.

lines.text: 내가 도와줄게요!
lines.en: I will help you!

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님의 머리를 물 위로 받쳐 주었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.
segs: The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.

lines.text: 인어공주는 첨벙첨벙 파도를 헤치고 밤새 헤엄쳤어요.
lines.en: Splish, splash! The little mermaid swam through the waves all night long.
segs: Splish, splash! The little mermaid swam through the waves all night long.

lines.text: 밤새 헤엄친 인어공주는 마침내 바닷가에 닿았어요.
lines.en: After swimming all night, the little mermaid reached the shore.
segs: After swimming all night, the little mermaid reached the shore.

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님을 모래밭에 눕히고, 바위 뒤에 숨었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.
segs: The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.

lines.text: 아침 해가 반짝 떠오르고, 갈매기가 끼룩끼룩 울었어요.
lines.en: The morning sun rose, all sparkly, and the seagulls cried, squawk, squawk.
segs: The morning sun rose, all sparkly, and the seagulls cried, squawk, squawk.

lines.text: 그때 하얀 옷을 입은 아가씨가 사뿐사뿐 걸어왔어요.
lines.en: Just then a young lady in a white dress came walking along, light as a feather.
segs: Just then a young lady in a white dress came walking along, light as a feather.

lines.text: 어머, 괜찮으세요?
lines.en: Oh my, are you all right?
segs: Oh my, are you all right?

lines.text: 왕자님은 아가씨에게 웃어 주었어요. 인어공주는 보지 못했지요.
lines.en: The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.
segs: The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.

lines.text: 왕자님이 깨어났어요. 다행이에요.
lines.en: The prince is awake. I am so glad.
segs: The prince is awake. I am so glad.

lines.text: 인어공주는 바위 뒤에서 살금살금 바다로 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: From behind the rock, the little mermaid slipped back into the sea, quiet as can be.
segs: From behind the rock, the little mermaid slipped back into the sea, quiet as can be.

lines.text: 궁전으로 돌아온 인어공주는 한숨을 폭폭 쉬었어요.
lines.en: Back at the palace, the little mermaid sighed and sighed, hoo, hoo.
segs: Back at the palace, the little mermaid sighed and sighed, hoo, hoo.

lines.text: 인어공주가 할머니 곁에 앉아 물었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid sat beside Grandmother and asked a question.
segs: The little mermaid sat beside Grandmother and asked a question.

lines.text: 할머니, 사람은 어떻게 살아요?
lines.en: Grandmother, how do people live?

lines.text: 사람은 땅 위에서 살고, 우리는 바다에서 살지. 사람에겐 별처럼 영원히 남는 마음이 있단다.
lines.en: People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.
segs: People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.

lines.text: 인어공주의 눈이 별처럼 반짝반짝 빛났어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid's eyes sparkled, twinkle, twinkle, like stars.
segs: The little mermaid's eyes sparkled, twinkle, twinkle, like stars.

lines.text: 나도 왕자님 곁에서 그런 마음을 갖고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.
segs: I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.

lines.text: 인어공주는 소용돌이 너머 바다 마녀를 찾아갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.
segs: The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.

lines.text: 소용돌이가 빙글빙글 돌고, 가마솥이 보글보글 끓고 있었어요.
lines.en: The whirlpool spun round and round, and the cauldron went bubble, bubble.
segs: The whirlpool spun round and round, and the cauldron went bubble, bubble.

lines.text: 마녀가 찾아온 인어공주에게 말했어요.
lines.en: The witch spoke to the little mermaid who had come to see her.
segs: The witch spoke to the little mermaid who had come to see her.

lines.text: 다리를 갖고 싶다고? 좋아. 대신 네 고운 목소리를 다오.
lines.en: You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.
segs: You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.

lines.text: 다리는 조금 흔들흔들할 거야. 그리고 왕자가 다른 사람과 결혼하면, 너는 바다 거품이 된단다.
lines.en: Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.
segs: Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.

lines.text: 그래도 갈래요.
lines.en: I will go anyway.

lines.text: 마녀가 가마솥을 휘휘 젓자, 반짝반짝 약이 생겼어요.
lines.en: The witch stirred the cauldron, swirl, swirl, and a sparkling potion appeared.
segs: The witch stirred the cauldron, swirl, swirl, and a sparkling potion appeared.

lines.text: 마녀가 목소리를 진주처럼 가져갔어요. 이제 인어공주는 말을 할 수 없어요.
lines.en: The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.
segs: The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.

lines.text: 인어공주는 약을 가지고 사람들의 궁전으로 헤엄쳐 갔어요.
lines.en: With the potion, the little mermaid swam to the human palace.
segs: With the potion, the little mermaid swam to the human palace.

lines.text: 새벽, 궁전 계단에서 인어공주는 약을 마셨어요.
lines.en: At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.
segs: At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.

lines.text: 꼬리가 사라지고 다리가 생겼어요! 걸음은 흔들흔들.
lines.en: Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.
segs: Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.

lines.text: 뚜벅뚜벅, 누군가 계단을 내려왔어요. 왕자님이었어요!
lines.en: Clomp, clomp, someone came down the steps. It was the prince!
segs: Clomp, clomp, someone came down the steps. It was the prince!

lines.text: 계단에서 인어공주를 발견한 왕자님이 물었어요.
lines.en: The prince saw the little mermaid on the steps and asked a question.
segs: The prince saw the little mermaid on the steps and asked a question.

lines.text: 누구세요? 어디서 왔어요?
lines.en: Who are you? Where did you come from?
segs: Who are you? Where did you come from?

lines.text: 인어공주는 말을 못 해요. 그저 웃었지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.
segs: The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.

lines.text: 우리 궁전에서 지내요.
lines.en: Come and stay at our palace.
segs: Come and stay at our palace.

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님 뒤를 아장아장 따라갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid toddled along behind the prince, wobble, wobble.
segs: The little mermaid toddled along behind the prince, wobble, wobble.

lines.text: 궁전 정원에는 꽃이 활짝활짝 피고, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날았어요.
lines.en: In the palace garden the flowers bloomed wide open, and butterflies fluttered, flit, flit.
segs: In the palace garden the flowers bloomed wide open, and butterflies fluttered, flit, flit.

lines.text: 인어공주는 날마다 왕자님과 정원을 사붓사붓 거닐었어요.
lines.en: Every day the little mermaid strolled softly through the garden with the prince.
segs: Every day the little mermaid strolled softly through the garden with the prince.

lines.text: 왕자님이 인어공주에게 다정하게 말했어요.
lines.en: The prince spoke gently to the little mermaid.
segs: The prince spoke gently to the little mermaid.

lines.text: 바다에서 온 아이 같아요. 내 귀여운 동생처럼 지내요.
lines.en: You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.
segs: You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.

lines.text: 인어공주는 흔들흔들해도 왕자님과 함께 춤추었어요.
lines.en: Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.
segs: Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.

lines.text: 빙글빙글 돌 때마다 발이 아팠지만, 인어공주는 방긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: Every time she twirled round and round, her feet hurt, but the little mermaid smiled sweetly.
segs: Every time she twirled round and round, her feet hurt, but the little mermaid smiled sweetly.

lines.text: 어느 날, 커다란 배에 꽃이 주렁주렁 걸렸어요.
lines.en: One day, the great ship was hung with flowers, bunches and bunches of them.
segs: One day, the great ship was hung with flowers, bunches and bunches of them.

lines.text: 그 배에 왕자님과 인어공주, 이웃 나라 공주님이 모였어요.
lines.en: The prince, the little mermaid, and a princess from a nearby kingdom were on the ship.
segs: The prince, the little mermaid, and a princess from a nearby kingdom were on the ship.

lines.text: 왕자님이 이웃 나라 공주님에게 말했어요.
lines.en: The prince spoke to the princess from the nearby kingdom.
segs: The prince spoke to the princess from the nearby kingdom.

lines.text: 당신이 모래밭에서 저를 구해 준 분이군요!
lines.en: You are the one who saved me on the beach!
segs: You are the one who saved me on the beach!

lines.text: 왕자님은 하얀 집 아가씨를 보고 활짝 웃었어요.
lines.en: The prince looked at the young lady from the white house and smiled a big, wide smile.
segs: The prince looked at the young lady from the white house and smiled a big, wide smile.

lines.text: 왕자님은 이웃 나라 공주님과 결혼했어요. 인어공주는 말없이 웃었어요. 마음은 아팠지요.
lines.en: The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.
segs: The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.

lines.text: 종소리가 댕댕 울리고, 인어공주는 혼자 뱃머리에 서 있었어요.
lines.en: The bells rang, ding, dong, and the little mermaid stood all alone at the front of the ship.
segs: The bells rang, ding, dong, and the little mermaid stood all alone at the front of the ship.

lines.text: 새벽, 배 옆에 언니들이 올라왔어요. 긴 머리가 짧아졌어요.
lines.en: At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.
segs: At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.

lines.text: 언니들이 배 위의 인어공주에게 속삭였어요.
lines.en: The sisters whispered to the little mermaid on the ship.
segs: The sisters whispered to the little mermaid on the ship.

lines.text: 마녀에게 머리카락을 주고 이 단검을 받았어.
lines.en: We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
segs: We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.

lines.text: 해가 뜨기 전에 이걸 왕자에게 쓰면 너는 다시 인어가 돼. 그러지 않으면 거품이 되는 거야.
lines.en: If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
segs: If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.

lines.text: 언니가 내민 단검을 인어공주가 받아 들었어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid took the dagger her sister held out.
segs: The little mermaid took the dagger her sister held out.

lines.text: 인어공주는 잠든 왕자님과 공주님을 보았어요. 그리고 고개를 저었지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.
segs: The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.

lines.text: 인어공주는 왕자님이 행복하기를 마음속으로 조용조용 빌었어요.
lines.en: In her heart, ever so quietly, the little mermaid wished for the prince to be happy.
segs: In her heart, ever so quietly, the little mermaid wished for the prince to be happy.

lines.text: 인어공주는 단검을 칼집째 바다에 던졌어요. 물결이 붉은 금빛으로 반짝였어요. 해가 떠올랐어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.
segs: The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.

lines.text: 인어공주는 반짝이는 거품이 되어 하늘로 둥실 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.
segs: The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.

lines.text: 거품은 햇살을 받아 알록달록 무지개빛으로 빛났어요.
lines.en: The bubbles caught the sunlight and shimmered in all the colors of the rainbow.
segs: The bubbles caught the sunlight and shimmered in all the colors of the rainbow.

lines.text: 아침 바다 위로 배가 조용히 흘러갔어요.
lines.en: The ship sailed gently across the morning sea.
segs: The ship sailed gently across the morning sea.

lines.text: 인어공주는 부드러운 바닷바람이 되었어요. 길 잃은 배의 돛을 밀어 주고, 더운 날엔 시원한 바람을 보내지요.
lines.en: The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.
segs: The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.

lines.text: 휘잉~ 바람이 불자 돛이 펄럭펄럭, 배가 쑥쑥 나아갔어요.
lines.en: Whoosh! The wind blew, the sails flapped, flap, flap, and the ship sailed on and on.
segs: Whoosh! The wind blew, the sails flapped, flap, flap, and the ship sailed on and on.

lines.text: 갈매기들이 끼룩끼룩, 바람을 따라 춤을 추었어요.
lines.en: The seagulls cried, squawk, squawk, and danced along with the wind.
segs: The seagulls cried, squawk, squawk, and danced along with the wind.

lines.text: 사랑하는 마음은 사라지지 않아요. 안녕, 또 만나요!
lines.en: A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!
segs: A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!

lines.text: 사랑하는 마음으로 양보하면, 그 마음은 좋은 일이 되어 남아요.
lines.en: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.
segs: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.
